core_change_summary.description: In ZoomBorder.cs, dispose the old bitmap source when a new child image is set, preventing memory leaks. Also update README.md to document the disposal requirement, and add a bitmap swapping sample in AvaloniaDemo that demonstrates proper cleanup logic.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation and demo sample illustrate the importance of disposing replaced bitmaps to avoid memory accumulation.
